wording_differences: Java stderr is ERROR, then the line number, then the message plus " (Assumed diagram type: state)".
Rust stderr is "parse error: line N: " plus the same message, and the process exits 1.
The message body and the stderr line number match on all five rejections.
The error-page banner counts @startuml, so its "From string (line …)" is one higher than the stderr line. That banner is not the Rust contract.
residue: Matching Java's error-page SVG and exit 200 is not this packet. The frozen error contract is ParseError and exit 1.
